name: Laurel
intro: Laurel is a neighborhood kitchen in Logan Square, built on the idea that a good dinner does not need to be complicated. We cook seasonally, we bake our own bread, and we keep the wine list short and honest. Come as you are, stay as long as you like.

notes.title: Private events
notes.body: Our back room seats twenty-four for dinner and forty standing. We handle the food, the wine and the timing; you handle the guest list.

notes.title: Walk-ins
notes.body: The bar is always kept for walk-ins. If the dining room is full, there is usually a seat at the counter.

demo.text: Demo site. Laurel is a fictional restaurant, built to show what a small-business site can do.
